# Subway Seat for Tilix

Palette, cursor, selection highlight, bold and badge colors. Tilix doesn't switch color schemes with the system style, so pick one flavor.

[Tilix](https://gnunn1.github.io/tilix-web/) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/tilix/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
Subway Seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
Subway Seat Tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
Subway Seat Enamel
```

**London Moquette**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
London Moquette
```

**London Deep Level**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
London Deep Level
```

**London Portland**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
London Portland
```

**Paris Guimard**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
Paris Guimard
```

**Paris Catacombes**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
Paris Catacombes
```

**Paris Carrelage**, in Preferences › Profiles › Color › Color scheme:

```text
Paris Carrelage
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/subway-seat.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/subway-seat-tunnel.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/subway-seat-enamel.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/london-moquette.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/london-deep-level.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/london-portland.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/paris-guimard.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/paris-catacombes.json`.
- Delete `~/.config/tilix/schemes/paris-carrelage.json`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
